notes: Validated against Serganov, Huang & Patel Nature 2009 (doi:10.1038/nature07642). 3F4E: same structure as 1fmn-fmn-riboswitch but this case focuses on metalCoordination. CRYSTALLOGRAPHIC Mg BRIDGE (M1): inner-sphere coordination between FMN phosphate oxygen O1P and G33 N7. This bridging Mg positions the phosphate moiety and is the 'crystallographic Mg' referenced in the case title. Stacking: isoalloxazine intercalates between A48 (below) and A85 (above) — same as FMN case. The metalCoordination term should fire when OA atoms of FMN phosphate land within 3.5 Å of Mg positions in the receptor.
